citation: Meadow, Richard H., ed. 1991. Harappa Excavations 1986–1990: A Multidisciplinary Approach to Third Millennium Urbanism. Monographs in World Archaeology No. 3. Madison, WI: Prehistory Press. ISBN 9780962911019 / 0962911011. OCLC 260159093.
notes: Edited field-report compilation for five seasons (1986–1990) at Harappa directed by George F. Dales (UC Berkeley) with J. Mark Kenoyer; later HARP continuity under Meadow/Kenoyer/Wright with Pakistan Dept. of Archaeology. Chapters include urban process (Kenoyer), production (Wright), fauna (Meadow), and season summaries (Dales/Kenoyer). Tier P as excavation/report compilation. TOC and chapter PDFs hosted on harappa.com (accessed 2026-10-11). No unverified page-level stratigraphic claims in this seed beyond the volume’s stated 1986–1990 Harappa scope.
